checks.fresh-install: Codespaces network report includes a successful fresh-cache locked installation
checks.access: GitHub, Copilot CLI, and editor are authenticated with the intended account
checks.workspace: Unique synthetic label, passing tests, running page, and discovered repository agent

checks.implementation: Page improvement implemented and covered by a focused passing test
checks.customizations: Path-scoped instructions and prompt created, discovered, and invoked with evaluator JSON
checks.browser: Completed page inspected using built-in browser tools and compared with the intended change
checks.review: Diff and staged files reviewed; code and customization files committed

checks.session: Real interactive CLI task, context/session controls, and scoped tool request observed
checks.programmatic: Bounded programmatic task actually executed and its output checked
checks.delegation: Delegation produced a real remote task with an inspected session reference

checks.reviewed-commit: Exact tested commit was reviewed and pushed to the rehearsal repository
checks.actions: Deploy workflow succeeded for that commit using the prepared runner identity
checks.endpoint: Downloaded deployment result and fresh requests verify health, label, and local samples
checks.no-azure-login: No attendee Azure login or credential creation was used

checks.seed: Three synthetic source vendors seeded under the unique rehearsal label without deleting custom rows
checks.implementation: Form, validated server-side POST, scoped filter, unassessed state, and mocked failure tests implemented
checks.transport: Redirect and credential boundaries checked with passing regression coverage before live service calls
checks.deployed-journey: Final exact-commit deployment shows Dataverse; browser submit, reload, and scoped filtering verified
checks.no-azure-login: Dataverse uses prepared environment credentials; no Azure CLI authentication fallback

checks.issue-session: Focused synthetic issue assigned to the actual cloud agent with an inspected session
checks.iteration: Precise PR correction requested and resulting changes inspected
checks.pr-tests: Tests and checks passed on the actual PR commit, not an unrelated branch
checks.human-review: Required human review completed without bypassing branch protections

checks.configuration: Authenticated remote GitHub MCP exposes only the intended read-only tools
checks.invocation: Actual MCP call returned the rehearsal issue and matched its GitHub source
checks.cleanup: Connection disabled if required by the agreed rehearsal policy

checks.automation: Matching issue event started the configured Copilot automation, not a manual substitute
checks.report-pr: Automation produced an inspected generated-report PR with unchanged evaluator results
checks.live-hook: Hook wiring loaded in a real CLI session and recorded metadata-only tool events
checks.deny: Harmless exact-tool denial observed and compared with its direct helper test
checks.cleanup: Test automation disabled and temporary deny flag removed

checks.discovery: Authored agent and skill discovered and actually invoked
checks.missing-evidence: Missing input and silent-source cases do not invent facts or evaluator JSON
checks.semantics: Negative encryption, undefined retention, residency contradiction, and unstated SOC 2 counterexamples pass
checks.handoffs: Actual analyst, writer, and reviewer invocations used original source and unchanged evaluator JSON
checks.baseline: Agent-authored report compared against untouched separate CLI baseline and source quotes
checks.commit: Authored customization files reviewed and committed
